preparation and approval of a lift study

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: fire on HO-9403 during an intrusive maintenance task

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 2 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control DROP_ZONE_EXCLUSION: the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work on HO-9403 and M-9403 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the preparation and approval of a lift study on HO-9403 and M-9403 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on HO-9403 and M-9403 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically supporting a load for maintenance access. HO-9403 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the exclusion of people from beneath elevated work was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 19 May 2008 an incident occurred on HO-9403 and M-9403 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during an intrusive maintenance task, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
